# Synthetic Tokens

## Token rules

You should derive every token from one base unit. Never hand-tune a single screen, because the next screen drifts. Prefer semantic names and avoid raw hex values in components. When a token changes, regenerate the sheet.

## Install

npm install -g synthetic-tokens
